searches.reason: Explore replacing the fixed recent-summary gate with input-dependent gates over causal convolution scales, while preserving NextItNet residual blocks and identity shortcuts. This could distinguish persistent interests from changing intent without assuming recent events are always more useful; deletion diagnostics do not establish that assumption.

searches.reason: Investigate a substantial change to the learning objective: jointly train the existing NextItNet network against multiple informative negatives using sampled-softmax correction or ranking losses. Large sampled-negative margins alongside weak catalog ranking motivate this direction, but do not prove its benefit. Seek inexpensive mining and safeguards against treating plausible alternatives as definite negatives.

searches.reason: Explore jointly learning item representations from available titles and descriptions alongside item IDs within one NextItNet model, using a lightweight text encoder trained from scratch. This could capture specific content and compatibility cues where explicitly documented, without external weights, unavailable metadata, separate fitted scorers, or inferred ownership needs.
